pr_title: feat(@caia/ui,chiefaia-site,dashboard): voice-to-text on every free-text field
pr_body:
## Summary

Voice-to-text on every free-text field, via one new `@caia/ui` primitive.

- **`@caia/ui` → `VoiceInput` + `VoiceField`** — mic button that dictates into any controlled text field. Click or **Ctrl+M** to toggle, pulse ring while listening, live interim text, locale from `navigator.language`, `aria-label` + `aria-live` status region.
- **apps/chiefaia-site** — contact form: name, email, message.
- **apps/dashboard** — submit "Requirement / Idea" brief intake, `HumanGateModal` feedback, `RequirementsKanban` title + description, `QuestionsKanban` custom answer, chat prompt.

### Reuse-first (ADR-065)

Not written from scratch. The SpeechRecognition lifecycle, Web Speech API type declarations and capability detection are **adapted from `speech-input.tsx` in [vercel/ai-elements](https://github.com/vercel/ai-elements)** (Apache-2.0, © Vercel) — new root `NOTICE`, with the full delta list in the component header so it can be re-synced upstream.

Vendored rather than depended upon because AI Elements ships as a shadcn-style *source registry* (components are copied in by design, as with shadcn/ui), and `speech-input` is not yet published to `registry.ai-sdk.dev`.

Alternatives evaluated and rejected: `react-speech-input` (pins React 18, renders its own input → ADR-065 violation), `react-speech-recognition` (hook only, no UI, adds a runtime dep for strictly less coverage), `react-speech-kit` / `use-speech-recognition` (unmaintained since 2022).

**One new runtime dependency:** `lucide-react` (ISC, zero deps, React 19 supported) — the canonical shadcn icon set, scoped to `packages/ui` only, so apps keep importing just the wrapper.

### What upstream didn't cover

| Added | Why |
|---|---|
| `aria-label` + `aria-live` status | Upstream renders a button with **no accessible name** — a WCAG blocker |
| Interim transcripts surfaced | Upstream sets `interimResults = true` but only ever emits `isFinal` |
| Ctrl+M, scoped to the focused field | A window-wide binding would start all three contact-form mics at once |
| Locale from `navigator.language` | Upstream hardcodes `en-US` |
| Token-driven inline styles | `apps/dashboard` ships **no Tailwind**, so a class-only button renders unstyled there |

### Deliberately not wired

- **Password / API-key fields** (`settings/runtime-keys`, wizard onboarding). The browser sends transcripts to a third-party speech service, so secrets must never be dictated — `VoiceField`'s `sensitive` prop makes the rule explicit and a test asserts the invariant.
- **The dashboard's one-line filter/search boxes** — dictation adds little there.
- **`/dashboard/new-project`** — still a read-only factory explorer with no intake form (per #745). No form was invented to hang a mic on.

## Tests

- `tests/voice-input.test.tsx` — 10 new: mic click starts recognition (mocked `SpeechRecognition`), second click stops, result populates the input, interim surfaced without committing, locale from `navigator.language`, screen-reader announcement, and the **unsupported-browser fallback** renders a disabled, self-explaining mic.
- Updated `tests/contact-form.test.tsx`: each field now has a second labelled control (its mic), so `getByLabelText(/name/i)` became ambiguous — selectors made exact.
- Full site suite **99/99 green**; `typecheck` and `lint --max-warnings 0` clean; `reuse-check-strict` reports 0 new findings.

## Note

Also bumps `packages/ui` to React 19 types/peers. The apps have shipped React 19 since #695; the package still declared 18-only, which only surfaced once a typed third-party component was imported into it.

Unticketed — extends #744 / #745.

pr_title: feat(wizard): backend phase 1 — Postgres + auth/project/tokens API + client sync
pr_body: First real backend for the wizard. Users, projects, sessions, and a token ledger persist to Postgres. Existing UI (localStorage-only) now migrates to the DB on login via a new syncToBackend() call.
